sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: passing a non-Copy value by value transfers ownership, and any later use is rejected at compile time.
sketches.resonance: What has been given away is not morally available to be given again.

sketches.mechanism: Subtype range constraints: assigning a value outside the declared range raises Constraint_Error.
sketches.resonance: A self constrained to only the present cannot survive even the smallest increment of time.

sketches.mechanism: The __END__ token stops compilation; subsequent text remains in the file but is no longer executed as program code.
sketches.resonance: After an ending, marks may remain, but they lose the power to change the world.
